must_report_unprovable.why: two validated settlements from the same payer for the same tool inside the declared window are reported as 'indistinguishable from two intended calls on this surface' - grouping UNPROVABLE - not as a double charge. The provider observes payer, tool, amount and time, and no buyer-side operation id, so the two readings cannot be separated.
must_report_unprovable.observed_but_not_claimed: 2 same-payer same-tool settlement pairs inside the 120s window (one with a failed first attempt, one with two successes)

must_report_unprovable.why: the gateway sees a failed call followed by a later settled call, and nothing that says the later call was a retry of the earlier one. No row carries retry_of (0/13). A report that prints retry_inflation = 0 has converted an unknown into a zero.
must_report_unprovable.observed_but_not_claimed: one failed-then-settled sequence for the same payer and tool

must_report_unprovable.why: no operation identifier is observable at the provider boundary, so no row carries operation_id (0/13) and every attempt resolves to operation_resolution = unknown. Operation Count for this sample is not 0 operations, it is unresolved grouping.

2 advisory decisions have no observed selection because no subsequent action by the same payer arrived inside the window. Silence is ambiguous - a deliberate hold, a departure, or a slow caller are indistinguishable here. The observed selections (2) are a lower bound, not a rate: 2/4 must not be published as a selection rate.
must_report_unprovable.observed_but_not_claimed: 4 advisory decisions, 2 with an observed selection

must_report_unprovable.why: the provider sees an opaque MCP client and a payer wallet, not a chooser. Whether the choice was made by a model, a workflow, a policy engine or a human is not observable, so decision_authority is unknown on every selection row and caller.type is unknown on every row.

the gateway returns an advisory and, separately, observes whether a later action request arrives. It does not observe that the agent read the advice, nor that the action was influenced by it. No effect_confirmed and no task_outcome row is emitted: a returned report does not establish agent action.
must_report_unprovable.observed_but_not_claimed: advice codes and later request ids in the provider-native log

must_report_unprovable.why: the provider never sees the caller's next request, so whether a result was consumed is not observable at all. No result_consumed row is emitted - absent, not zero.

must_not_invent: no default price: every amount comes from the provider-native log, the two prices are synthetic and constant per tool in this fixture
no zero for absence: unresolved grouping stays UNPROVABLE, never 0
no fabricated identity: caller.type / decision_authority stay unknown, only a hashed payer key is carried
no outcome upgrade: a returned report never becomes resolved, effect_confirmed or task_outcome
no double-charge claim: a repeated settlement is reported as grouping UNPROVABLE, never as an overcharge
no settlement invented for an unpaid challenge: an unpaid challenge carries a presentation and nothing else
negative_results_policy: A report that disagrees with any must_assert value is a finding about my mapping or your measurement - either is welcome; both are more useful than agreement.
